checkedAlternates.risk: The SA node initiates the electrical impulse seen on an ECG.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The SA node is a physical anatomical cluster of pacemaker cells in the right atrium (group-1), not an ECG voltage deflection (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: The mitral valve separates the left atrium and left ventricle.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The mitral valve is a one-way leaflet valve (group-3), not a pumping chamber (group-2).
